title: Do the repository's results feeds contain the season the league published?
rule: Total games played is derived from the official standings (sum of every club's W+L+T, divided by 2). Total points is the sum of the official PF column. A feed either reproduces those identities or it is short, and the shortfall is a number, not an opinion.

closure.identity: points in the best feed's weeks 1-9 corpus + points in the official Week-10 finals = the league's own published total points scored
